assertion.objects: Primitive holomorphic weight-two cusp form of level N and trivial character; exact-divisor Atkin-Lehner matrices and its differential line.
assertion.hypotheses: The form is genuinely primitive/new at level N, with trivial multiplier. The actual quotient differential is supplied separately.
assertion.quantifiers: Every p^e exactly dividing N, including p=2 and every exponent e.
assertion.parameter_range: Positive integral level, characteristic zero, holomorphic weight two.
assertion.uniformity: No scalar action on an arbitrary oldspace is claimed.
assertion.constants: Eigenvalue w_(p^e) is +1 or -1, with no formula for its value asserted.
assertion.normalizations: Source weight2k with k=1; determinant-normalized right slash equals differential pullback. Source W_q is determinant q^alpha.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No squarefree or odd-prime restriction; no inference of root-number or twist formulas.
assertion.limit_order: Use the already constructed primitive form, apply the source theorem, then the separate quotient argument.
assertion.statement: Every primitive weight-two newform of trivial character is an eigenform with sign plus or minus one for each exact-prime-power Atkin-Lehner operator.
